data.title: School — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: school
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Let's get this party started!)

[Hook]
In the classroom… En la clase
We all gather… Nos reunimos
Time to learn… Hora de aprender
Birthday fun… Fiesta de cumple
Hey, hey, hey… Vamos a jugar

[Verse]
Balloons are floating, laughter in the air,
The blackboard… La pizarra, teacher's drawing there.
The eraser… El borrador, cleaning up the board,
The pen… El bolígrafo, stories to be scored.

Thank you… Gracias, for the gift you gave,
The pencil sharpener… El sacapuntas, keeping thoughts so brave.
The backpack… La mochila, full of dreams and more,
The dictionary… El diccionario, opening every door.

[Hook]
In the classroom… En la clase
We all gather… Nos reunimos
Time to learn… Hora de aprender
Birthday fun… Fiesta de cumple
Hey, hey, hey… Vamos a jugar

[Verse]
The computer… El ordenador, showing us the way,
The schedule… El horario, guiding every day.
The teacher… La maestra, with a smile so bright,
Making learning easy, turning on the light.
